أبتدع (form VIII)
# أَبْتَدِعُ (ʔabtadiʕu) /ʔab.ta.di.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# أُبْتَدَعُ (ʔubtadaʕu) /ʔub.ta.da.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# أَبْتَدِعَ (ʔabtadiʕa) /ʔab.ta.di.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# أُبْتَدَعَ (ʔubtadaʕa) /ʔub.ta.da
